title: WooCommerce Website Design Dubai | The Brandle
description: WooCommerce website design and development in Dubai. A custom WordPress store you own outright, with payments, delivery and 5% VAT set up and tested.

hub.name: WooCommerce design
hub.line: A shop you own outright, plumbing included.

hero.joke: A shop with no landlord. You own the building, and also the plumbing.
hero.intro: WooCommerce website design and development in Dubai. A custom store on WordPress with payments, delivery and VAT set up properly. You own the code and the data, and there's no monthly platform fee. Fixed quote, 3 to 6 weeks.

items.p: Shop, product, basket and checkout pages designed for your catalogue and built as a lightweight theme.
Card payments through a gateway that suits your business, plus Tabby or Tamara instalments and cash on delivery if your customers expect them.
Delivery zones, rates and 5% UAE VAT configured, with invoices that show what they should.
WooCommerce gets slow when neglected. Caching, image handling and a strict plugin diet keep it quick.
Products, customers and orders moved from your old store, with every old address redirected.
How to add products, process orders and issue refunds. Plus every login, because it's your shop.

fit.p: WooCommerce is free, open and yours. It also needs hosting, updates and someone who cares. Shopify costs a monthly fee and looks after itself. Neither is better. They suit different owners.
yes: Already on WordPress and adding a shop
Unwilling to pay a platform fee every month
Selling products with unusual options or rules
Set on owning your data and your hosting
fit.no: you want to sell and never think about servers. That's [Shopify](/services/shopify-website-design/), and there's no shame in it. Undecided? Start at [ecommerce website design](/services/ecommerce-website-design/).

items.p: A free call about catalogue, delivery and payments. Then a written scope and a fixed quote.
Shop pages designed in Figma around your real products, not placeholder trainers.
Theme, products, gateway, delivery and tax, assembled on a staging site you can poke at.
A test order on every payment method, redirects live, training done. Free fixes for 30 days.

price.p: Our fixed plans run from $1,299 to $6,499, about AED 4,800 to 23,900, and a store takes 3 to 6 weeks. WooCommerce itself is free. Hosting, gateway fees and any paid plugins are separate, and we list them in the quote.

tools.note: Built on WooCommerce and WordPress. Tabby and Tamara are instalment options we can connect. Shopify is here because we'll tell you when it's the better answer.

faq.a: Shopify is quicker to launch and hosted for you. WooCommerce gives you ownership and no platform fee, in exchange for maintenance. [Shopify vs WooCommerce](/blog/shopify-vs-woocommerce/) has the full comparison.

faq.q: Can you move my existing store?
faq.a: Yes. Products, customers and order history come across, and old addresses are mapped to new ones so links and search results keep working.
You own the hosting account. We recommend a host that suits WooCommerce and set it up with you. Keeping it updated afterwards can sit under a [maintenance plan](/services/website-maintenance/).

faq.q: Which payment gateways can you connect?
faq.a: That depends on your trade licence, your volumes and where your customers are. The [payment gateway integration](/services/payment-gateway-integration/) page explains how we choose.
